question_text: Maria had 12 $\frac{11}{15}$ cans of orange paint stored in the garage. She used 6 $\frac{9}{15}$ cans to decorate her room. How many cans of orange paint did Maria have left?\nWrite your answer as a fraction or a mixed number.  _ _/_ cans
solution: Find the amount of orange paint left by subtracting 6 $\frac{9}{15}$ from 12 $\frac{11}{15}$.
Since both fractions have the same denominator, subtract whole numbers from whole numbers and fractions from fractions.\n$12 \frac{11}{15} - 6 \frac{9}{15} =$ ?
Subtract the whole numbers: 12 - 6 = 6\nSubtract the fractions: $\frac{11}{15} - \frac{9}{15} = \frac{2}{15}$
Combine the results: 6 $\frac{2}{15}$
Maria had 6 $\frac{2}{15}$ cans of orange paint left.
